findings.title: totalPages is off by one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit
findings.body: In admin-group.js.es6, totalPages is computed as Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. With 100 members and limit 50 this yields 3 pages when there are only 2. The Next button stays enabled on page 2, and clicking it sets offset to 100, which requests an empty page. The same formula is used for showingLast, so the last-page logic is also wrong. Use Math.ceil(user_count / limit) instead.

findings.title: members endpoint accepts unbounded or negative limit/offset
findings.body: The public members action reads limit as params[:limit] || 50 with no upper bound and offset with no lower bound. A caller can request limit=1000000 to pull the whole membership in one response, which is costly for large groups. A negative limit or offset is passed straight to SQL LIMIT/OFFSET and will raise a database error (500). Clamp limit to a sane maximum and reject or clamp negative values.

findings.title: create action silently drops alias_level
findings.body: The admin UI sends alias_level in asJSON() when creating a group, but create only sets name and visible. A group created with an alias level selected in the form is saved with the default alias level and no error is shown. Set alias_level in create as update does.

findings.title: Remove link shown for automatic groups because automatic is not in member context
findings.body: The group_member item view renders each member as its context, so {{#unless automatic}} looks up automatic on the User object, where it is undefined. The remove link therefore appears even for automatic groups, where the server rejects removal with a 422. The flag must be passed from the group controller into the item view or the template.

findings.title: Public group members page now shows only the first page of members
findings.body: The public members endpoint is now paginated with a default limit of 50, and the public group/members template has no pagination controls. Groups with more than 50 members will show only the first 50 on the public members page, a regression from loading all members for non-automatic groups.

findings.title: remove_member spec issues a PUT to a DELETE-only route
findings.body: The 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' example calls xhr :put, :remove_member, but routes.rb only defines remove_member under delete "members". The test may fail on routing or test the wrong verb. It should use :delete.

findings.title: Coverage for incremental add/remove and non-existent users was dropped
findings.body: The removed PATCH specs covered adding a non-existent user (silent success), removing a non-member, and the automatic-group guard. The new add_members and remove_member specs cover only the automatic-group rejection and one happy path, so the silent-skip behaviour for unknown usernames is no longer tested.
